title: Three Winters of Waiting for Ice
subtitle: 气候变化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）
meta: 主题语境：气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）　|　核心词汇：process　|　正文 352 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 process 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My grandfather measured the lake every January for forty-one years, which makes his notebook one of the longest records of a single ① process in this county. The ② process itself is unremarkable: water cools, ice thickens, ice thins, water warms. What is remarkable is that the middle two steps have been shrinking since 1998, and that he noticed before anyone paid him to.

I helped for three winters. The ③ process took twenty minutes and two people, one to hold the rope and one to be cold. We drilled, measured, wrote it down, and walked back. He never once called it science; he called it a job that had to be done in the same order every time, because a ④ process done differently is two processes and neither of them means anything.

In March the numbers went to a university, where they were ⑤ processed by a woman who had never seen the lake and who found, inside forty-one years of pencil, a pattern my grandfather had refused to guess at. She rang to thank him. He said the thanks belonged to the ⑥ process, not to him, which I thought was modesty and now think was method.

The lake is not what it was. Two of the four springs that feed it have failed, the ice now forms three weeks later than it did, and a ⑦ process that used to be predictable has become a rumour. In the ⑧ process of losing it, the village has also lost an argument it did not know it was having: whether a thing you cannot see changing is changing. An application to protect the lake was ⑨ processed in eleven months, by which time the ice had gone.

He died in April, and the notebook went to the university with everything else. I have his drill and, more usefully, his instructions. The process continues without him, which is the point of a process: outlive the person, outlast the argument. ⑩ In the process, I have learned the only thing he never wrote down — that measuring is a kind of care, and that a record kept badly is worse than none.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. （自然、物理的）变化过程
C. n. 工序；步骤；操作流程
D. v. 处理（数据、材料等）
E. v. 处理、受理（申请、文件等）
F. 固定搭配：in the process of doing 在……的过程中
G. 固定搭配：in the process 与此同时；在此期间
H. n. 做法；方法（强调按部就班）

items.q: a single process in this county
The process took twenty minutes and two people
a process done differently is two processes
they were processed by a woman
the thanks belonged to the process
a process that used to be predictable
In the process of losing it
An application to protect the lake was processed
In the process, I have learned

answers.why: 指被长期记录的那一整套“过程、进程”，即湖水结冰消融的年度循环。
指自然的“变化过程”，后文逐步说明：水变冷、冰变厚、冰变薄、水变暖。
指具体的“操作流程、步骤”：打孔、测量、记录、走回。
同样强调“工序、做法”，说做法一变就等于两套数据，都失去意义。
动词，意为“处理（数据）”，指大学里有人整理这些数字。
指“做法、步骤”本身，祖父说功劳属于这套做法而不是他个人。
再次指自然变化过程，说原本可预测的结冰过程已成了传闻。
in the process of doing 意为“在……的过程中”，此处说在失去湖的同时也输了争论。
动词，指“受理、处理（申请）”——保护湖区的申请被拖了十一个月。
in the process 单独使用，意为“与此同时、在此期间”，引出作者自己的体会。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 他的笔记本是本县某一过程最长的记录之一。（process）
整个过程需要二十分钟和两个人的配合。（process）
做法一变，就等于两套数据。（process）
这些数字后来由一所大学处理。（process v.）
保护湖区的申请被拖了十一个月才受理。（process v.）
与此同时，我学到了他从未写下的一件事。（in the process）
answers: His notebook is one of the longest records of a single process in this county.
The whole process took twenty minutes and two people.
A process done differently is two processes, and neither of them means anything.
The numbers were later processed by a university.
The application to protect the lake was processed in eleven months.
In the process, I learned the only thing he never wrote down.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 process 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: My grandfather's notebook is one of the longest records of a single process in this county.
The process itself is unremarkable: water cools, ice thickens, ice thins, water warms.
The process took twenty minutes and two people, and he insisted it be done in the same order every time.
The numbers were later processed by a woman who had never seen the lake and who found a pattern in them.
An application to protect the lake was processed in eleven months, by which time the ice had gone.
In the process, I learned the only thing he never wrote down: measuring is a kind of care.
